question: Can I obtain a complete offline Excel copy of the Bitable view displayed by this Feishu or Wiki link?
trigger: A user has a Feishu Bitable view URL
A user has a Wiki URL with table and view parameters that displays a Bitable
A user cannot copy a read-only Bitable but can view it
decision: Stop and resolve access, mapping, or completeness failures before relying on the export
evidence: User-provided complete Feishu Bitable or current-view Wiki URL
Data returned to the current authorized browser page
View metadata and record count where applicable
success_measure: A clean installation produces a readable XLSX containing the current displayed Bitable view's visible fields and all records whose completeness can be proven.
outcome: One locally saved validated XLSX workbook and optional same-name media directory.
intended_users: Users with legitimate Feishu Bitable read access
input_types: HTTPS Feishu /wiki/ URL with table and view parameters

examples.invocation: /feishu-bitable-export 把这个飞书多维表格导出为 Excel

permissions_systems: Read access through an isolated user-authorized Feishu browser session
Write access for requested local XLSX path
typical_completion_time: 1-10 minutes depending on record count and media

readiness_checks: Current page exposes the target Bitable

permissions: Write local XLSX and optional media directory

authoritative_sources: Data exposed to the authorized Feishu Bitable web view
relationships: A Wiki current page may expose one displayed Bitable whose Base is resolved by successful same-origin metadata response
field_semantics: Visible field order comes from view metadata; select option IDs map to display labels; media links remain associated with their cells
invariants: Direct and Wiki-resolved Bitable metadata must be accepted by code 0; unfiltered unique records equal metadata count; real filtered views require completion evidence
freshness_and_pagination: Initial response can be partial; subsequent records merge by ID and progress is guarded
nullability: Cell values and media links may be absent; table/view/field metadata is required

should_trigger: 导出 Wiki 页面显示的多维表格
把只读多维表格导出为 xlsx
should_not_trigger: 递归导出 Wiki 子页面
